facts.fact: 庆典开幕：彩纸烟花 matraca；乐队走街丰收季；酒馆男人烂醉
facts.anchor: The festival was a riotous burst of color.

facts.fact: 咖啡馆赴约：Perla 盛装艳压（瓷娃娃妆效）；Inés 平底鞋黄丝带，桌下踢了他胫骨一脚
facts.anchor: In the cramped café, his leg touched hers by accident, and she kicked him in the shin.

facts.fact: 虎面具传统：山虎吃牛被猎杀→男人扮虎；神父解为「人性放纵的象征」
她目送 Ulises 一秒后邀 Bartolo 共舞；他整晚盯着她、想起十七岁没敢吻的女孩
facts.anchor: Her eyes fixed on Ulises for a second, wide and eager, but she shifted her gaze to Bartolo.

facts.fact: 他借口离席戴上 Bartolo 落下的虎面具追进人潮——她正与红手帕陌生人共舞
facts.anchor: He felt the coolness of the forgotten mask under his fingertips

facts.fact: 巷内：摘面具相拥；她嫌他磨蹭「别背十四行诗」主动解皮带——野合
facts.anchor: “Can I kiss you or will you slap me?” he asked.

facts.fact: 事毕她一句「Estrella 会等我」就走；他挽留转圈吻别
facts.anchor: “Estrella will be expecting me,” she said, and the simplicity of the remark felt bruising.

facts.fact: 收尾：她捧了一下他的脸奔出巷子；他靠墙心跳如鼓，两分钟后拾面具原路返回
facts.anchor: She looked up at him and raised a hand to carefully cup his face
